summary: Verified iteration-64 bulk-password-reset + force-change-password flow end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass — legacy 3 (hansenayda, stmobilest2027, maham89706) all log in with Welcome-2026 and receive password_change_required=true; sophia_style demo1234 correctly rejected (401); admin untouched (password_change_required=false); /auth/me exposes must_change_password; /auth/change-password works without old_password when flag set, requires+validates old_password otherwise, rejects <6 char with 400, rejects missing JWT with 401; /admin/users/bulk-password-reset temp mode affects 913 users, non-admin JWT gets 403, unknown mode gets 400, only_missing_hash mode succeeds. Frontend: (a) legacy user login force-redirects to /change-password with amber 'temporary one' banner visible, old-password field hidden, new+confirm+submit rendered — submit redirects to /. (b) Admin > /admin/users renders 'Bulk reset (legacy)' button with data-testid=users-bulk-reset-btn (count=1, visible). (c) 390px mobile flow works: no horizontal overflow, inputs are 44px tall, force-redirect to /change-password succeeds. Live state restored via bulk-reset with temp='Welcome-2026' — 913 users on Welcome-2026, all 3 legacy verified logging in with password_change_required=true, sophia_style verified on Welcome-2026.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' from TrustStrip — pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration but worth cleaning up

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 7750 lines. New endpoints admin_reset_user_password + admin_bulk_password_reset ideal candidates to move into routers/admin_users.py.
bulk-password-reset uses to_list(20000) which is a hard cap — if user count ever exceeds this, silent partial reset. Consider iterating with paginated cursor or documenting the cap.

must_change_password enforcement is client-side only (Login.jsx redirect + ChangePassword page). A user could bypass by not calling /auth/me / not honoring the flag and hit other endpoints with their JWT while flagged. Consider server-side middleware that 403s non-/auth/change-password /auth/me requests when the flag is set — depending on threat model.
TrustStrip on homepage triggers React key warning (pre-existing) — surfaced in console during this run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (desktop force-redirect+submit, admin bulk button, mobile flow all verified)
